find_breweries_nearby.description: Find the breweries closest to a latitude and longitude, nearest first, each with how far away it actually is. get_breweries_by_ids.description: Read several breweries at once from a list of IDs, in the order you asked for them. Open Brewery DB looks up 6 at a time and returns them in its own order, dropping any ID it does not have; this step splits a longer list across requests, puts the order back and reports the IDs that are not in the dataset instead of losing them.

description: Look up breweries, brewpubs, taprooms and cideries anywhere in the world from Open Brewery DB, the free open-source brewery dataset. Search by name, filter by country, state, city, postal code or brewery type, find the ones nearest a set of coordinates with the distance to each, pull a whole region in one step, count what matches before you fetch it, or pick one at random. No account or API key is required.
